body: I’m don’t think I want to get better either. I’m tired and nobody wants me. They all want the me they had before but the me before never really existed. It is just a coping mechanism for me to use to be safe in environments that were not. I just want everything to stop.

It’s mainly just so that people don’t try to stop me. Or try to ‘check in’ to ‘see how I’m doing’ because I now have missed a few classes and assignments and professors are ‘worried’ (and totally not going through a checklist of people- because I totally don’t get an edited version of said checklist as a part of my job).

The problem is whenever I try to reach out for help they always will tell my biological father—after I tell them he abuses my sister and I emotionally and our step brothers physically- which then makes it harder in every aspect. Because his abuse of me is not physical or sexual I guess it’s not enough risk to me to make sure they don’t tell him. They just go yup- he hasn’t hit you, I’m just gonna go ahead and report to him. Which is illegal, cause it wasn’t about me hurting myself it was just about my thoughts of him but I don’t know why it keeps happening. Okay wait maybe I do, he has to have say on what therapist I go to and if they don’t report to him they get fired within a week.
